reviewNotes: Mobile plan retains title/lobby/archive/deck/profile/save/audio flows from the current desktop plan. This is an authored plan, not execution evidence.

At review_input inspect the actual original screenshot; respond only with normal logged click/drag/pointer_hold/wait. Never read or inject Unity/Core/hand/seed/save state. Maximum20 bounded actions per response,12 iterations enforced by the harness.
First deployment review must reach a visible own terrain and unit through normal play and return to an unlocked own preparation. Do not assume randomized hand order or deploy unavailable cards.

Before save, inspect current actual resolution evidence. If needed continue ordinary Ready turns to obtain a real coin/result capture and an unlocked battlefield; retain all attempted original frames. A blank/nonblank canvas or idle field is not proof of coin animation.
Whole media catalog remains a separate strict gate; missing artwork is not accepted as recovered original art.

Compact menu/Ready positions are calculated from actual DrawCompactBattleRail pixel-row geometry at346px canvas height. If canvas height differs, recompute before execution; normalized x alone does not fix pixel-anchored row positions.

Compact rail coordinates were corrected after observing the actual616x346canvas. Browser viewport height390 is not canvas height. Preserve the interrupted first run and verify ordinary initial/selected/coin/settled labels again.

compactRailGeometry.formula: top-origin y = 1 - 0.977 + (15 + 23 * rowIndex) / canvasHeight; rail x=.817..979

observedCanvas.scope: Actual ordinary Chromium canvas; compact rail uses fixed-pixel rows. Earlier390px-canvas assumptions hit Card Detail when shuffle was intended.
